_doc: Frases de K01–K03 publicadas em 482ec74 (antes da jornada). IDs posicionais: estes textos não podem mudar.

sentences.K01-B1-S1: I wake up at around 5:00 a.m.
sentences.K01-B1-S2: I take a shower, get ready and leave for work.
sentences.K01-B2-S1: I work at a club as a personal trainer and Pilates instructor.
sentences.K01-B2-S2: From 7:00 to 11:00 a.m., I work with my personal training clients.
sentences.K01-B3-S1: I go for lunch at around 11:10 a.m.
sentences.K01-B3-S2: From 12:30 to 1:30 p.m., I do my own workout.
sentences.K01-B4-S1: From 2:00 to 4:30 p.m., I teach group Pilates classes.
sentences.K01-B5-S1: From 5:30 to 6:30 p.m., I work with my last personal training client.
sentences.K01-B6-S1: I get home at around 7:10 p.m.
sentences.K01-B6-S2: I organise dinner for my family and the children's snack.
sentences.K01-B6-S3: I plan the next day, take a shower and wait for my husband.
sentences.K01-B6-S4: We have dinner and talk, and I usually go to bed at around 10:00 p.m.
sentences.K02-B1-S1: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, I finish my classes at around 3:00 p.m.
sentences.K02-B1-S2: I do my workout at 4:00 p.m.
sentences.K02-B1-S3: I get home at around 5:30 p.m.
sentences.K03-B1-S1: When a client cancels in advance, I can sleep until 6:00 a.m. and leave later.
sentences.K03-B2-S1: If a client doesn't come and there's a chance at the club, I can join a spinning class.
sentences.K03-B3-S1: When I can't work out at lunchtime, I can go for a run at another time.

questions.K.Q1: What time do you usually wake up?
questions.K.Q2: What do you do in the morning at work?
questions.K.Q3: When do you do your own workout?
questions.K.Q4: What do you teach in the afternoon?
questions.K.Q5: What do you do when you get home?
questions.K.Q6: What is different on Tuesdays and Thursdays?
questions.K.Q7: What do you do if you can't work out at lunchtime?
